# Automation Contract Reference (Auto-Generated)

:::note
This page is auto-generated by `scripts/generateControlDocs.js` from `app/control/contract.js`, the single declaration of what the automation interfaces expose. Do not edit it by hand. After changing the contract, run `npm run generate-control-docs` and commit the result.
:::

Teams for Linux offers two interfaces to other programs: [MQTT](mqtt-integration.md) on any platform, and a [D-Bus service](development/dbus-control.md) on the Linux session bus. Both describe the same things, the Teams state the app observes and the actions it can perform. This page lists them in one place, so you can see what you expose when you enable either interface and what each transport can and cannot do. Each interface is opt-in: `mqtt.enabled` for MQTT and `dbusControl.enabled` for D-Bus.

The MQTT side is also available as an AsyncAPI 3.0 document, [mqtt-asyncapi.json](https://ismaelmartinez.github.io/teams-for-linux/mqtt-asyncapi.json), for tools that read AsyncAPI.

## Observed state

Values are what the app observed, not state confirmed by Teams. D-Bus reports the selected profile, except `incomingCall` and `incomingCallCaller`, which describe the latest ringing call whichever profile it rings in, while MQTT publishes what any profile reports. The gate column names the option that must be on for the field to carry anything, and the personal data column marks fields that describe other people. The MQTT microphone topics never carry `unknown`: that value only appears in the D-Bus snapshot, before a microphone state has been observed.

| Field | Meaning | Type and values | Gate | Personal data | MQTT topic | D-Bus signal |
|-------|---------|-----------------|------|---------------|------------|--------------|
| `presenceStatus` | Your Teams presence as a stable name; unknown until Teams reports it. | `string`: `unknown` or `available` or `busy` or `do_not_disturb` or `away` or `be_right_back` | none | no | `status` (JSON, retained) | `PresenceChanged` |
| `presenceStatusCode` | The numeric presence code Teams reported, an integer in the int32 range, -1 until Teams reports one. A code outside the known ones is kept, and the presence status for it is unknown. | `integer` | none | no | `status` (JSON, retained) | `PresenceChanged` |
| `inCall` | Whether a call is connected. | `boolean` | none | no | `in-call` (text, retained) | `InCallChanged` |
| `incomingCall` | Whether a call is ringing. | `boolean` | none | no | `incoming-call` (text, retained) | `IncomingCallChanged` |
| `incomingCallCaller` | Who is calling while a call rings: scenario, number, name, queue, contact and callId, each present only when Teams supplies it. The option governs both transports. | `object or null` | `mqtt.incomingCallCaller.enabled` | yes | `incoming-call/caller` (JSON, not retained) | `IncomingCallCallerChanged` |
| `cameraEnabled` | Whether your camera is on in the call. | `boolean` | none | no | `camera` (text, retained) | `CameraChanged` |
| `microphoneState` | The microphone as observed: speaking or silent while unmuted, muted, off outside a call, unknown when not observed. | `string`: `speaking` or `silent` or `muted` or `off` or `unknown` | none | no | `microphone` (text, retained) | `MicrophoneChanged` |
| `microphoneControlState` | The microphone reduced to what a mute toggle needs: muted, unmuted (speaking or silent), off or unknown. | `string`: `muted` or `unmuted` or `off` or `unknown` | none | no | `microphone/control` (text, retained) | `MicrophoneControlChanged` |
| `screenSharing` | Whether you are sharing your screen. | `boolean` | none | no | `screen-sharing` (text, retained) | `ScreenSharingChanged` |
| `meetingStarted` | A pulse that is true when a scheduled meeting is detected as started, and returns to false when you join or the reset delay passes. | `boolean` | `mqtt.meetingStartDetection.enabled` | no | `meeting-started` (text, retained) | `MeetingStartedChanged` |
| `callParticipants` | The remote participants on the call stage, each with a name and whether they are speaking; null outside a call. Experimental, read from Teams markup. | `array or null` | `dbusControl.callParticipants` | yes | none | `CallParticipantsChanged` |

## Commands

A command is an action another program can ask for. The MQTT action and D-Bus method columns show how each transport reaches it; "not available" means that transport has no way to ask for it.

| Command | Arguments | Effect | MQTT action | D-Bus method |
|---------|-----------|--------|-------------|--------------|
| `toggleMute`: Toggle the microphone mute. | none | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `toggle-mute` | `ToggleMute() -> b` |
| `mute`: Mute the microphone. Does nothing when it is already muted; when the observed state is neither muted nor unmuted it acts only with force. | `force` (boolean, optional) | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `mute` | `Mute(b force) -> b` |
| `unmute`: Unmute the microphone. Does nothing when it is already unmuted; when the observed state is neither muted nor unmuted it acts only with force. | `force` (boolean, optional) | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `unmute` | `Unmute(b force) -> b` |
| `toggleVideo`: Toggle the camera. | none | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `toggle-video` | `ToggleVideo() -> b` |
| `toggleHandRaise`: Raise or lower your hand. | none | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `toggle-hand-raise` | `ToggleHandRaise() -> b` |
| `leaveCall`: Leave the current call. | none | Sends a keyboard shortcut to Teams | `leave` | `LeaveCall() -> b` |
| `acceptAudio`: Answer the ringing call with audio only. | none | Answers or declines a ringing call | not available | `AcceptAudio() -> b` |
| `acceptVideo`: Answer the ringing call with video. | none | Answers or declines a ringing call | not available | `AcceptVideo() -> b` |
| `declineCall`: Decline the ringing call. | none | Answers or declines a ringing call | not available | `DeclineCall() -> b` |
| `setStatus`: Set your Teams presence. offline can be set but is never observed. | `status` (string, required) | Changes your presence | not available | `SetStatus(s status) -> b` |
| `getState`: Return the observed state as one JSON object. | none | Returns observed state | not available | `GetState() -> s` |
| `getCalendar`: Publish your calendar events between two dates. Needs the Graph API integration. | `startDate` (string, required), `endDate` (string, required) | Exports calendar events | `get-calendar` | not available |

Neither transport reports whether Teams carried an action out: D-Bus methods return whether it was dispatched, and MQTT sends no reply.

## MQTT

### Connection and delivery

Every message is published with QoS 0. The availability topic `<topicPrefix>/connected` carries `true` while the app is connected and `false` otherwise, and is retained. The broker publishes `false` on this topic as the last will when the app disconnects without saying so; the app publishes `true` on connect and `false` on a clean disconnect.

The client id is set with `mqtt.clientId` (default `teams-for-linux`). The app leaves the clean session flag (`true`) and the keep-alive interval (60 seconds) at the MQTT library's defaults.

### Topics

Every topic is published under `mqtt.topicPrefix` (default `teams`). The subtopic of each can be renamed with the option in the second column.

| Topic | Subtopic option | Payload | Retained | Gate | Carries |
|-------|-----------------|---------|----------|------|---------|
| `<topicPrefix>/status` | `mqtt.statusTopic` (default `status`) | JSON object with `status`, `statusCode`, `timestamp`, `clientId` | yes | none | `presenceStatus`, `presenceStatusCode` |
| `<topicPrefix>/in-call` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.inCall` (default `in-call`) | text: `true` or `false` | yes | none | `inCall` |
| `<topicPrefix>/incoming-call` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.incomingCall` (default `incoming-call`) | text: `true` or `false` | yes | none | `incomingCall` |
| `<topicPrefix>/meeting-started` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.meetingStarted` (default `meeting-started`) | text: `true` or `false` | yes | `mqtt.meetingStartDetection.enabled` | `meetingStarted` |
| `<topicPrefix>/camera` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.camera` (default `camera`) | text: `true` or `false` | yes | none | `cameraEnabled` |
| `<topicPrefix>/microphone` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.microphone` (default `microphone`) | text: `speaking` or `silent` or `muted` or `off` | yes | none | `microphoneState` |
| `<topicPrefix>/microphone/control` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.microphoneControl` (default `microphone/control`) | text: `muted` or `unmuted` or `off` | yes | none | `microphoneControlState` |
| `<topicPrefix>/screen-sharing` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.screenSharing` (default `screen-sharing`) | text: `true` or `false` | yes | none | `screenSharing` |
| `<topicPrefix>/incoming-call/caller` | `mqtt.mediaTopics.incomingCallCaller` (default `incoming-call/caller`; `<incomingCall>/caller` when the option is unset) | JSON object with `scenario`, `number`, `name`, `queue`, `contact`, `callId`, `timestamp`, `clientId` | no | `mqtt.incomingCallCaller.enabled` | `incomingCallCaller` |
| `<topicPrefix>/calendar` | fixed `calendar` | JSON object with `success`, `data` | no | `graphApi.enabled`, `mqtt.commandTopic` | command `getCalendar` |

### Commands

Commands are read from `<topicPrefix>/<mqtt.commandTopic>` as a JSON object with an `action`. The option is empty by default, which turns command reception off. Actions the table does not list are ignored.

| Action | Command | Arguments | Example message |
|--------|---------|-----------|-----------------|
| `toggle-mute` | `toggleMute` | none | `{"action":"toggle-mute"}` |
| `mute` | `mute` | `force` (boolean, optional) | `{"action":"mute","force":true}` |
| `unmute` | `unmute` | `force` (boolean, optional) | `{"action":"unmute","force":true}` |
| `toggle-video` | `toggleVideo` | none | `{"action":"toggle-video"}` |
| `toggle-hand-raise` | `toggleHandRaise` | none | `{"action":"toggle-hand-raise"}` |
| `leave` | `leaveCall` | none | `{"action":"leave"}` |
| `get-calendar` | `getCalendar` | `startDate` (string, required), `endDate` (string, required) | `{"action":"get-calendar","startDate":"2026-01-05T00:00:00Z","endDate":"2026-01-09T23:59:59Z"}` |

### Home Assistant entities

With `mqtt.homeAssistant.enabled` the app publishes retained discovery messages under `homeassistant/<component>/<clientId>/<objectId>/config` on every connect. For the default topics and a command topic of `command` they create these entities; the buttons are left out when no command topic is set.

| Component | Object id | Name | Reads or writes |
|-----------|-----------|------|-----------------|
| `sensor` | `status` | Teams Status | `teams/status` |
| `sensor` | `microphone` | Teams Microphone | `teams/microphone` |
| `binary_sensor` | `in_call` | Teams In Call | `teams/in-call` |
| `binary_sensor` | `screen_sharing` | Teams Screen Sharing | `teams/screen-sharing` |
| `binary_sensor` | `camera` | Teams Camera | `teams/camera` |
| `binary_sensor` | `incoming_call` | Teams Incoming Call | `teams/incoming-call` |
| `binary_sensor` | `meeting_started` | Teams Meeting Started | `teams/meeting-started` |
| `button` | `toggle_mute` | Teams Toggle Mute | `teams/command` |
| `button` | `toggle_video` | Teams Toggle Video | `teams/command` |
| `button` | `toggle_hand_raise` | Teams Toggle Hand Raise | `teams/command` |
| `button` | `leave` | Teams Leave Call | `teams/command` |

## D-Bus

The service lives on the user session bus, on Linux only.

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Bus name | `dbusControl.busName` when set; otherwise `$FLATPAK_ID` or `com.github.IsmaelMartinez.teams_for_linux` |
| Object path | `/com/github/IsmaelMartinez/teams_for_linux` |
| Interface | `com.github.IsmaelMartinez.teams_for_linux.Control` |

### Methods

Signatures are D-Bus type signatures (`b` boolean, `s` string, `i` int32). A method returns `true` when the action was dispatched. `GetState` returns the whole observed state as a JSON string.

| Method | Signature | Command |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `AcceptAudio` | `AcceptAudio() -> b` | `acceptAudio` |
| `AcceptVideo` | `AcceptVideo() -> b` | `acceptVideo` |
| `DeclineCall` | `DeclineCall() -> b` | `declineCall` |
| `ToggleMute` | `ToggleMute() -> b` | `toggleMute` |
| `Mute` | `Mute(b force) -> b` | `mute` |
| `Unmute` | `Unmute(b force) -> b` | `unmute` |
| `ToggleVideo` | `ToggleVideo() -> b` | `toggleVideo` |
| `ToggleHandRaise` | `ToggleHandRaise() -> b` | `toggleHandRaise` |
| `LeaveCall` | `LeaveCall() -> b` | `leaveCall` |
| `SetStatus` | `SetStatus(s status) -> b` | `setStatus` |
| `GetState` | `GetState() -> s` | `getState` |

### Signals

`StateChanged` carries the whole state as JSON on every change. The others carry one field, or two for presence, and fire only when that field changes.

| Signal | Signature | Arguments | State carried |
|--------|-----------|-----------|---------------|
| `StateChanged` | `s` | `stateJson` | `presenceStatus`, `presenceStatusCode`, `inCall`, `incomingCall`, `incomingCallCaller`, `cameraEnabled`, `microphoneState`, `microphoneControlState`, `screenSharing`, `meetingStarted`, `callParticipants` |
| `PresenceChanged` | `si` | `status`, `statusCode` | `presenceStatus`, `presenceStatusCode` |
| `InCallChanged` | `b` | `inCall` | `inCall` |
| `IncomingCallChanged` | `b` | `incomingCall` | `incomingCall` |
| `IncomingCallCallerChanged` | `s` | `callerJson` | `incomingCallCaller` |
| `CameraChanged` | `b` | `enabled` | `cameraEnabled` |
| `MicrophoneChanged` | `s` | `state` | `microphoneState` |
| `MicrophoneControlChanged` | `s` | `state` | `microphoneControlState` |
| `ScreenSharingChanged` | `b` | `sharing` | `screenSharing` |
| `MeetingStartedChanged` | `b` | `started` | `meetingStarted` |
| `CallParticipantsChanged` | `s` | `participantsJson` | `callParticipants` |
